query:
-- Update bracket totalPoints and correctPicks for FirstFour-0 correct picks (Texas, 5pts each)
UPDATE brackets b
SET 
  totalPoints = totalPoints + (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.pointsEarned), 0) 
    FROM picks p 
    WHERE p.bracketId = b.id AND p.matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') AND p.isCorrect = 1
  ),
  correctPicks = correctPicks + (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM picks p 
    WHERE p.bracketId = b.id AND p.matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') AND p.isCorrect = 1
  )
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM picks p 
  WHERE p.bracketId = b.id AND p.matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') AND p.isCorrect = 1
);

-- Update user totalPoints for correct picks
UPDATE users u
SET totalPoints = totalPoints + (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.pointsEarned), 0)
  FROM picks p
  WHERE p.userId = u.id AND p.matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') AND p.isCorrect = 1
)
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM picks p
  WHERE p.userId = u.id AND p.matchupId IN ('FirstFour-0', 'FirstFour-3') AND p.isCorrect = 1
);

-- Mark the new Howard game as scored
UPDATE gameResults SET isScored = 1 WHERE matchupId = 'FirstFour-3' AND isComplete = 1;

-- Verify: show leaderboard preview (bracket game points)
SELECT u.name, MAX(b.totalPoints) as gamePoints, MAX(b.correctPicks) as correct
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN brackets b ON b.userId = u.id AND b.year = 2026
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY MAX(b.totalPoints) DESC
LIMIT 10;
